sources.title: Efficient Minimum Distance Estimation of Pareto Exponent from Top Income Shares
sources.snippet: We propose an efficient estimation method for the income Pareto exponent when only certain top income shares are observable. Our estimator is based on the asymptotic theory of weighted sums of order statistics and the efficient minimum distance estimator. Simulations show that our estimator has excellent finite sample properties.
